meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会带你按步骤在已有 AKS 集群上配置 AI Runway:核对集群、装控制器、评估 GPU、装推理 provider、部署首个模型并验证就绪。
howto.when: 当你提到「setup AI Runway」「onboard AKS cluster」「install AI Runway」等说法,或要求把模型部署到 AKS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我在这台 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway 控制器
say.note: 会先核对集群状态,再执行安装。

say.text: 评估一下这个集群的 GPU 适合部署什么模型
say.note: 检测 GPU 型号并指出精度限制。

say.text: 把第一个模型部署到 AKS 并确认已就绪
say.note: 选模型、部署并验证 Ready。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks you through setting up AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster: verifying the cluster, installing the controller, assessing GPU, choosing a provider, and deploying the first model.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", or "install AI Runway", or ask to deploy a model to AKS.

say_en.text: Install the AI Runway controller on my AKS cluster
say_en.note: Checks cluster state first, then installs.

say_en.text: Assess what models this cluster's GPU can serve
say_en.note: Detects GPU model and dtype limits.

say_en.text: Deploy my first model to AKS and confirm it's Ready
